title: Development of the design and synthesis of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) – from large scale attempts, functional oriented modifications, to artificial intelligence (AI) predictions
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,367-395
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00432A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zongsu Han, Yihao Yang, Joshua Rushlow, Jiatong Huo, Zhaoyi Liu, Yu-Chuan Hsu, Rujie Yin, Mengmeng Wang, Rongran Liang, Kun-Yu Wang, Hong-Cai Zhou
The design and synthesis of MOFs have evolved from traditional large-scale approaches to function-oriented modifications, and recently to AI predictions, which save time, reduce costs, and enhance the efficiency to achieving target functions.
